name: TCS
recent: TCS 近期出现大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 的股权变动申报，并在 10 月中更换公司秘书。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 申报股权变动。
公司更换公司秘书，LEOW EE WEN 与 ANG WEE MIN 先后出任。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
risks: 大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 连续申报股权变动，需留意持股比例变化。

recent_en: TCS recently saw substantial shareholder interest changes by DATO' ONG KING SENG and changed its company secretaries in mid-October. It also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder DATO' ONG KING SENG reported changes in interest.
The company changed its company secretaries, with LEOW EE WEN and ANG WEE MIN appointed.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder DATO' ONG KING SENG filed consecutive interest changes; the shareholding level should be monitored.
